findings.claim: A single chip containing the main processing and memory functions of a device, replacing many separate components.
findings.truth: An integrated circuit is a compact circuit of interconnected electronic components on semiconductor material; it need not contain both processing and memory functions.
findings.evidence: Fetched Wikipedia Integrated circuit article: components are fabricated on a semiconductor chip and ICs can perform different functions, including processing, control or storage.

findings.claim: Modern coaster wheels sit in a C-shaped channel and grip the rail on three faces, making it mechanically impossible for the car to lift away from the track.
findings.truth: A typical coaster train uses road, side-friction and up-stop wheels, but track and wheel geometry varies by design. Option: replace the absolute claim with a general statement that these wheels guide and help secure the train; retain it only if this simplified three-face model is an intentional house convention.
findings.evidence: Fetched Wikipedia Roller coaster article: it identifies road, side-friction and up-stop wheels and describes their functions, but does not support one universal C-shaped arrangement or mechanical impossibility.

findings.claim: Engineers call embedding electronics into physical products the internet of things.
findings.truth: Embedding electronics alone is not the internet of things; IoT devices are connected so that they can interact or exchange data.
findings.evidence: Fetched NIST Internet of Things glossary: IoT devices are connected to the internet, and the network allows devices to connect, interact and exchange data.

findings.claim: The flashcard asks about miniaturisation but answers with a benefit of voice-activated control.
findings.truth: Voice-activated smart technology enables speech-only control for users with limited mobility; that is not an answer to a question about miniaturisation.
findings.evidence: Spec 3.1.2 names voice-activated smart technology; the lesson's own answer describes voice control rather than miniaturisation.

findings.claim: A person in a rural community in the UK has access to the same information and services as someone in a city centre.
findings.truth: Networks can improve rural access, but access is not the same: rural full-fibre coverage is lower than urban coverage.
findings.evidence: Fetched Ofcom Connected Nations UK Report 2025: UK full-fibre coverage is 81% of urban residential premises and 61% of rural premises; gigabit-capable coverage is 91% urban and 62% rural.

findings.claim: Embodied energy is the total energy consumed throughout the life of a material, from extraction and processing through to disposal or recycling.
findings.truth: Embodied energy is the energy required to produce a material or product. Disposal, recycling and use are lifecycle stages, not part of this definition.
findings.evidence: Fetched Wikipedia Embodied energy article: it defines embodied energy as the sum of energy required to produce goods or services.

findings.claim: Thermosetting plastics cannot be re-melted or recycled and must go to landfill or incineration.
findings.truth: Conventional thermosets cannot be remelted and remoulded after curing, but may be recovered as filler and specialist recycling routes exist. Option: add ‘by remelting’ wherever the lesson teaches the simplification; or retain the current simplified curriculum wording consistently.
findings.evidence: Fetched Wikipedia Thermosetting polymer article: cured thermosets cannot be melted and reshaped, but it notes filler recovery and specialist reprocessing or recycling developments.

findings.claim: Silicon (silicone) is presented as a thermosetting plastic.
findings.truth: Silicon is an elemental semiconductor, while silicone is a polymer; some silicone resins are thermosets. The specification itself lists ‘silicon’ among thermosetting plastics. Recommend resolving that specification anomaly before changing the house question; if authorised, use ‘silicone resin’.
findings.evidence: Spec 3.2.1 lists ‘silicon’ as a thermosetting example. Fetched Wikipedia Silicone article distinguishes silicone polymer from elemental silicon; fetched Thermosetting polymer article lists silicone resins as thermoset materials.

summary: Three lessons checked. Five verified issues have surgical fixes; three broader technical or specification conflicts need editorial adjudication.
